content.value: A Kaplan turbine produces 104 k W under a head of 30 m with an overall efficiency of 90%. The hub diameter is 4 times the outer diameter of the runner. Determine – (i) Diameters, (ii) The speed of the turbine assuming the speed ratio Ku = 1.5 and flow ratio = 0.65.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2020
